bullets.title: Global Bond Yields at Multiyear Highs; US 10Y at 4.75%
bullets.body: US 10-year Treasury yield hit 4.75%, its highest since January 2025, while German 30-year bonds sold at the highest yield since 2011 and Japan's 10-year hit a three-decade peak. The MOVE index spiked +605bps and the UST yield curve steepened to a new Quad 3 cycle high, with one commentator noting the move is decisively global and driven by massive corporate and government issuance calendars.

bullets.title: BofA Survey: Extreme Bullishness — 56% Overweight Equities, Cash at 3.5%
bullets.body: The August BofA fund manager survey shows net 56% overweight equities, the highest since November 2021, with cash allocations at 3.5%. Separately, 27% are overweight US stocks specifically, the highest since December 2024. Pattern-watchers note 2026 is on pace for 1,860 ETF launches, historically correlated with market peaks (2007: 291 launches, topped Oct 2007; 2022: 458 launches, topped Jan 2022).

bullets.title: BofA Survey: AI Bubble Is Now the #1 Tail Risk for Fund Managers
bullets.body: 32% of fund managers in the August BofA survey cite an AI bubble as the biggest tail risk, exceeding all other threats. Separately, 49% expect stagflation over the next 12 months (up from 47% in July), while 43% expect a boom — the highest recorded. Jackson Hole is in focus with Fed Chair Warsh expected to remain neutral, though 31% anticipate a hawkish signal.

bullets.title: Semis Weak: SOXX Down 3.5%; KOSPI -1.6% on Open
bullets.body: The SOXX semiconductor index is down 3.5% on the session, with pre-market commentary flagging AI/chip sector as a key source of downside pressure (NDX -1.1% pre-market). KOSPI fell 1.6% on the week open, with semiconductor momentum traders cited as a driver of volatility.

bullets.title: Iran/Hormuz Strait Closure Threat Driving Supertanker Rates to $510K/Day, Oil Above $90
bullets.body: Iran's top negotiator Qalibaf says the Hormuz Strait will remain closed until the US meets interim deal conditions. Oil supertanker rates are soaring toward $510,000/day, oil is holding above $90/barrel, and diesel crack spreads hit a record high described as 'absolutely unprecedented.' Gas price concern among Americans surged to 56% in a Pew survey, up from 34% in January.

bullets.title: TSMC Secures A16 Backside Power Edge Over Intel and Samsung
bullets.body: Korean media reports TSMC has validated its A16 process — the industry's first angstrom-class CMOS — giving it a technological edge in backside power delivery ahead of Intel and Samsung. The development is seen as a meaningful competitive gap in advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

bullets.title: AI Server Demand Causing 10-Month MLCC Lead Times for High-End Products
bullets.body: High-end MLCC lead times are approaching 10 months driven by AI server demand, while general-purpose products remain relatively stable. Murata is responding with a dual-pricing strategy — raising prices on high-end capacitors while cutting prices on low-end parts to defend share against Chinese and Taiwanese rivals.

bullets.title: Marvell PT Raised to $225 from $200 at TD Cowen
bullets.body: TD Cowen raised its price target on Marvell Technology to $225 from $200, reflecting continued confidence in the stock's growth trajectory.

bullets.title: CRWV and NBIS Featured in Neo-Cloud Deep Dive
bullets.body: A circulating CSI blog piece evaluates neo-cloud platforms CRWV and NBIS with full charting analysis, drawing attention from fintwit accounts tracking the space.

bullets.title: Taiwan's H1 GDP +14.15%, Strongest in 50 Years — Semiconductor-Driven
bullets.body: Taiwan recorded 14.15% H1 GDP growth, the strongest in 50 years, overwhelmingly attributed to its semiconductor boom. The government is distributing a ~$314 'AI dividend' to every citizen, and defense spending crossed 3% of GDP for the first time.

bullets.title: SPX Straddle Priced at $27.3/35bps Ahead of VIX Expiration
bullets.body: Today's SPX straddle is priced at $27.3/35bps (ref 7715), implying another low-vol session. Yesterday's cash move was 50bps and overnight ES moved 60bps; VIX expires tomorrow.

bullets.title: Japanese Life Insurers Sitting on $200B in Unrealized Bond Losses
bullets.body: As JGB yields rise to three-decade highs (+25bps over the past month), Japanese life insurers have accumulated an estimated $200 billion in unrealized losses on their bond portfolios — a macro stress point flagged by multiple accounts.

bullets.title: Klarna Q3 Revenue Guide $940M–$980M Misses $1.11B Consensus — 'And Crash'
bullets.body: Klarna guided Q3 revenue to $940M–$980M, well below the $1.11B consensus estimate. The sharp miss versus expectations prompted a terse 'and crash' reaction from one fintwit account.

bullets.title: Anthropic Tracking >$65B Annualized Revenue — 7x YoY Growth
bullets.body: Anthropic is reportedly on track to generate more than $65B in annualized revenue, representing over 7x growth year-over-year. The company is not publicly listed but the scale matters for AI competitive context across the universe.

bullets.title: Empire Manufacturing: Longer Delivery Times, Rising Backlogs, But Optimistic 6-Month Outlook
bullets.body: The August Empire Manufacturing Index (adjusted to 55 on ISM methodology) showed significantly longer delivery times and worsening supply availability, but manufacturers remain optimistic about the next six months, with new orders at multi-year highs. Consumer income expectations fell to 35.1%, with only 8% expecting real income gains above inflation.

bullets.title: Peter Thiel Has Exited Nvidia; Portfolio Now 72% Energy & Utilities
bullets.body: Three months after exiting his Nvidia position, 72% of Peter Thiel's public equity portfolio is now allocated to energy and utilities — a notable sector rotation from one of the most high-profile tech investors.

bullets.title: Gold Seen as Undervalued by Fund Managers — Most Bullish Since March 2023
bullets.body: Net 16% of fund managers in the August BofA survey describe gold as undervalued, up from 6% in July — the most bullish reading since March 2023. Commodities broadly are rallying in a Quad 3 reflation narrative while Treasury bonds continue to sell off.

bullets.title: Meta Now Largest Single Stock Position for at Least One Notable Account
bullets.body: One fintwit account disclosed that META has become their largest single-stock holding, signaling continued conviction on the name amid broader tech volatility.
